## WindowUpdateInput.frame property

Deprecated compatibility rectangle relative to the lower left corner of the screen. Use bounds instead. Omitted when iTerm cannot report it. Cannot be reset: null is rejected.

**Signature:**

```typescript
frame?: Rectangle;
```
